tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Search Junely’s daily-verified catalog of Colorado summer camps and after-school programs. Filter by child age, month, region, category, price, and open availability. Returns matches with honest, recently-verified enrollment status.

tools.name: get_program_details
tools.description: Full details for a single program by its Junely id (from search results): description, dates, ages, price, current enrollment status, and the provider’s info + registration links.

tools.name: whats_open
tools.description: Programs currently OPEN for registration, freshest first — Junely’s honesty signal. Optional filters: region, category, age, vertical.

tools.name: save_camp
tools.description: Saves a program to the signed-in user’s Junely watchlist. NOTE: saving also arms spot-opening/status-change email alerts for that program — identical to tapping ★ on junely.co. Only call when the user explicitly asks to save/track a program. Requires connecting the user’s Junely account.

tools.name: watch_program
tools.description: Sets a fills-up/closing email alert for one program on the signed-in user’s Junely account — identical to the “alert me” button on junely.co. Only call when the user explicitly asks to be alerted. Requires connecting the user’s Junely account.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_programs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Junely’s daily-verified catalog of Colorado summer camps and after-school programs. Filter by child age, month, region, category, price, and open availability. Returns matches with honest, recently-verified enrollment status." → after: "Search Junely’s catalog of Colorado summer camps and after-school programs, checked against each provider’s own page. Filter by child age, month, region, category, price, and open availability. Freshness is per row, not daily: every result starts from its captured extraction date (can be weeks old);"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
